description: Holds branch review team visit details records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review team visit details records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review team visit detail.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review team visit detail.
columns.business_meaning: Branch Review Team Visit Details identifier

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review team visit detail.

columns.name: team_member_id
columns.description: Team member id of the branch review team visit detail.

columns.name: no_of_fl
columns.description: No of fl of the branch review team visit detail.

columns.name: fl_visited
columns.description: Fl visited of the branch review team visit detail.

columns.name: no_of_bill
columns.description: No of bill of the branch review team visit detail.

columns.name: zero_visit
columns.description: Zero visit of the branch review team visit detail.

relationships.description: Each branch review team visit detail references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
common_queries: List branch review team visit details
Count of branch review team visit details
Branch Review Team Visit Details by branch review header

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewTeamVisitDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review team visit detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
